query: Recent French 2027 presidential first-round voting intention polls testing Marine Le Pen by name, June-July 2026, with pollster, fieldwork dates, and Le Pen percentage. Include Ifop, Harris Interactive, Toluna, Elabe, Odoxa, IFOP polls.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of what I found on French 2027 presidential first-round polls testing Marine Le Pen by name in June–July 2026:

**Key finding:** Le Pen announced her candidacy on July 7, 2026, after an appeals ruling restored her eligibility. Pollsters switched from testing Bardella to testing Le Pen by name, and her first-round figure jumped ~4 points (from ~32% to ~34–36%).

**Polls testing Le Pen by name:**
- **Ifop** (LCI/Le Figaro), July 7–8: **36%** — the headline post-announcement poll
- **Ifop** (LCI/Le Figaro/Sud Radio), June 22–24: **32%** (pre-announcement; Bardella tested at 36%)
- **Toluna Harris Interactive** (M6/RTL), July 7–8: **34–36%**
- **Toluna Harris Interactive** (M6/RTL) Wave 2, May 25–27: **31–32%** (just before the window)
- **Elabe** (BFMTV/La Tribune Dimanche), July 9–10: **~35%** (34–35.5%)
- **OpinionWay** (Les Échos/Radio classique PrésiTrack), July 8–9: **35%** (34–36% across scenarios)

**Notes:**
- **Odoxa:** No first-round vote-intention poll testing Le Pen by name was found for the window; Odoxa's July 2026 Le Figaro poll covered the "providential candidate" theme instead.
- **Harris Interactive** appears in the market as **Toluna Harris Interactive** (Harris is a Toluna subsidiary).
- One data discrepancy worth flagging: the July 7–8 Ifop sample size is reported as 984 (press/AFP) vs. 1,507 (SP2027 aggregator).
- In all post-announcement July polls, Le Pen leads every scenario, with Philippe second (~18–20%) and Mélenchon third (~13–16%).

The full structured findings, sources, and data points have been submitted.

sources.snippet: Ifop for LCI and Le Figaro: Le Pen well ahead at 36% in first two simulated rounds after her July 7 announcement; +4 points in two weeks.

sources.title: Presidentielle: Le Pen demarre sa campagne largement en tete (sondages)
sources.snippet: AFP: Ifop (July 7-8, 984 voters) Le Pen 36%; Toluna Harris Interactive (July 7-8, 1,592 voters) Le Pen 34-36%.

sources.title: Intentions de vote a l'election presidentielle 2027 - Toluna
sources.snippet: Toluna Harris Interactive Wave 2 for M6/RTL, fieldwork May 25-27, 2026, 1,744 voters; Le Pen 31-32%, Bardella 32-34%.

sources.title: Les Francais et l'election presidentielle 2027 - Elabe
sources.snippet: Elabe: Le Pen clearly first at 34%-35.5% in first round depending on configuration, +3 points since March 2026.

sources.title: Sondages Elabe presidentielle 2027 - SP2027
sources.snippet: Elabe for BFMTV/La Tribune Dimanche, July 9-10, 2026, sample 1,503, Le Pen 35%.

sources.title: Sondages Ifop presidentielle 2027 - SP2027
sources.snippet: Ifop July 7-8, 2026 Le Pen 36% (sample 1,507); Ifop June 22-24, 2026 Le Pen 32%, Bardella 36% (sample 1,415).

sources.title: Presidentielle 2027: Marine Le Pen en tete des intentions de vote au premier tour
sources.snippet: OpinionWay for Les Echos/Radio classique, fieldwork July 8-9 2026, 963 respondents; Le Pen 35% (34-36% across scenarios).

sources.title: Sondages presidentielle 2027: tous les resultats - SP2027
sources.snippet: Aggregator of first-round intentions from Ifop, Ipsos-BVA, Odoxa, Toluna Harris, Cluster17, OpinionWay, Elabe; Elabe July 9-10 2026 post-announcement.

sources.title: Presidentielle 2027 Sondage Odoxa: Dans l'attente de la personnalite providentielle?
sources.snippet: Odoxa for Le Figaro (July 2026): 47% still await a providential candidate; theme survey, not a first-round vote-intention with Le Pen percentage.

sources.title: Polls Show Le Pen Leading France's 2027 Presidential Election
sources.snippet: Reuters July 9: two polls suggest Le Pen could win 2027 despite upheld embezzlement verdict; pollsters stress not a forecast; first round April 18 2027.
